A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EchoONE study. All ten pages of each, including equations, eight figures, five tables and references, support reliable comparison. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v2 reports original internal and external segmentation evaluations, qualitative predictions and PC-Mask/LFFA ablations in Section 4, Tables 2–5 and Figures 6–8.

after.justification: v3 retains the work’s original segmentation evaluations and component ablations in Section 4, Tables 2–5 and Figures 6–8.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same SAM architecture, PC-Mask procedure, CNN branch, LFFA fusion and training objectives. Figure 3 redraws the existing procedure without introducing a method component or changing its steps.

E1.justification: Both use CAMUS and private datasets A–D internally, and HMCQU and EchoNet-Dynamic externally. The cardiac structures and six planes, evaluated as 2CH, 3CH, 4CH and grouped PSAX, are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 2–4 retain U-Net, DeepLabV3+, SwinUNet, H2Former, SAM, MedSAM, SAMed, SAM-Med2D, MSA and SAMUS. Comparator membership in Figures 1 and 6–8 also remains unchanged. The newly cited works are not evaluated.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 retain the subject-level 80/10/10 split, external evaluation design, preprocessing, augmentation, ViT-B backbone, 256×256 inputs, 100 training epochs and mDice/mIoU/HD95 metrics.

E4.justification: Table 5 retains the same four combinations of PC-Mask and LFFA. The analyses across planes, structures and datasets, together with Figure 8’s qualitative examples, are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates and averages without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or formal significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 2–5 and result Figures 1 and 6–8 retain their scores and qualitative findings. For example, Table 4 reports EchoONE mDice of 73.94 on HMCQU and 88.36 on EchoNet-Dynamic in both. Figure 3’s added similarity values illustrate the existing computation.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–6 for similarity, prior composition, feature fusion and losses are unchanged. Neither version adds formal assumptions, theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the claims of a uniform multi-plane model, PC-Mask and LFFA contributions, superior segmentation and accelerated convergence. Wording corrections do not change their scientific scope.

C2.justification: The explanations connecting PC-Mask to PSAX performance and LFFA to boundary refinement are retained. Both conclusions acknowledge ultrasound-only validation while asserting applicability to other medical modalities; no substantive limitation or qualification is added.

D1.justification: Table 1 corrects annotation codes 1/2/3 from LV/MYO/LA to LA/LV/MYO, matching Figure 5 in both versions. This corrects technical documentation without establishing changed preprocessing. Implementation settings, hardware and the promised code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 adds discussion of SPIn-NeRF and Multi-view Radar Semantic Segmentation, cited as references 27 and 30 in v3, to contextualize multi-view analysis outside medical imaging. Existing references and the central medical-imaging novelty position are retained.

P1.justification: v3 makes local grammar and spelling corrections throughout, explicitly identifies existing ablation gains as mIoU, updates author order and correspondence details, and adds an acknowledgment section. Bibliographic formatting changes, while the scientific narrative and section sequence remain stable.

P2.justification: Figure 3 is redrawn with explicit cluster–prototype–mask associations, numerical similarity examples and an expanded legend. Other figures receive small sizing adjustments. Table 1 adds a missing dash and corrects its caption; no figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves technical accuracy and readability through Table 1’s corrected annotation key, Figure 3’s clearer depiction of the existing procedure and language cleanup. The added related work supplies useful context. These are limited documentation improvements; the method and empirical support remain unchanged.
